overview_description.description: UrbanGo is a AI driven Mobility solution, focused on Incentivizing Sustainable Behavior with Green Tokens generated out of Verified Behavioral data.  The platform enables Corporates / Mobility providers to perform benchmarking of their Carbon Data and provide them with tools to analyze align their ESG initiatives. The multi-regression AI model works at analysing human behavior persona using multitude of data points to train the AI model and generating predictive analysis for human behavior. The AI model employed uses data to self learn and auto-evolve the training datasets for the algorithm.
